Peace of Mind Guarantee

Our 5-Point Safety & Workmanship Guarantee

When you invite Bara Electrical into your home or commercial site, you receive total protection and guaranteed standards compliance backed by Registered Electrical Contractor REC 29064.

1

Lifetime Workmanship Warranty

We stand behind every wire pulled, every circuit terminated, and every switchboard assembled. If any installation completed by our team requires adjustment due to workmanship, we rectify it promptly at zero cost to you.

2

Victorian Certificate of Electrical Safety (COES) Guarantee

Every eligible installation is lodged directly with Energy Safe Victoria (ESV), and you will receive your official Certificate of Electrical Safety. This guarantees that your insurance policy remains completely protected and your property conforms strictly to AS/NZS 3000:2018.

3

Fixed Upfront Pricing (No Bill Shock)

We never begin work without your explicit agreement on scope and price. We provide itemised, honest quotes with transparent parts and labour breakdown. If unexpected switchboard decay or obsolete wiring is discovered during testing, we stop and consult you before proceeding.

4

Full $20M Public Liability Insurance Coverage

Bara Electrical Servicing Pty Ltd maintains comprehensive $20 million public liability insurance. Your residential property, commercial assets, and family are completely shielded from risk throughout our attendance.

5

Spotless Clean-Up Promise

We respect your home as if it were our own. We use protective mats, vacuum up plaster dust and wire clippings, and remove all discarded cardboard packaging and old switchboard parts upon completion.
